description: This file defines the Utils::Telemetry struct, which provides static methods for telemetry logging, including initialization, sending messages, and reporting errors, conditioned on ENABLE_TELEMETRY_LOGGING macro.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: A utility struct offering static methods to initialize telemetry, send messages, and report errors, with optional compilation based on telemetry logging macro.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes telemetry system if ENABLE_TELEMETRY_LOGGING is defined.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a telemetry message with a fixed marker 'THUNDER_MESSAGE' or a custom marker if provided.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Logs an error message formatted with variadic arguments, sending it as a telemetry event with marker 'THUNDER_ERROR'.
